name: TGI Justice Project
description: Free reentry support, advocacy, and community resources for trans/intersex individuals
fullDescription: TGI Justice Project supports transgender, gender-variant, and intersex people inside and outside of prisons, jails, and other locked facilities, with reentry, housing, legal, and wellness programs at its Black Trans Cultural Center in San Francisco.
whatTheyOffer:
- Grassroots reentry and socio-economic program (employment and housing support)
- Housing and supportive services
- Legal services, including name and gender marker changes
- Wellness programs
- Black Trans Leadership Development
- Policy advocacy and Trans Liberation Tuesday (mail night for incarcerated people)
howToGetIt:
1. Call TGIJP at 415-554-8491 or email info@tgijp.org
2. Currently or formerly incarcerated trans, gender-variant, and intersex people welcome
3. Visit the center at 370 Turk St or 131 Franklin St, San Francisco
4. Receive reentry, housing, or legal support
5. Join community programs
keywords: TGI Justice Project, TGIJP, Black Trans Cultural Center, transgender, intersex, incarcerated, reentry, formerly incarcerated, housing assistance, name change, gender marker, mail night
